title: Split services/api/app/scenario/three_answers/three_way_document.py (599 lines) by moving the scope-line code to a new module three_way_scope_lines.py behind a compatibility facade, and close the three test gaps of DB-199 (a), (b), (c); the emitted 1.3.0 document stays BYTE-IDENTICAL for every committed fixture and test input and NO shown text changes (backlog rows DB-205 a and DB-199 a to c; CLAUDE.md principle 16).
objective:
FACTS TODAY. three_way_document.py is 599 lines (modularity warning is 600; CLAUDE.md principle 16; docs/CODE_MODULARITY_POLICY.md; .claude/rules/code-architecture.md). Its scope-line code is a self-contained block: the maps _SCOPE_BASIS_BY_SOURCE (lines 131-137), _NOT_KNOWN_VALUE / _NOT_APPLICABLE_VALUE / _WORDS_VALUE_BY_SOURCE (145-150), the design-choice keys HOUSING_PROGRAM_KEY / FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_KEY / USER_CHOICE_KEYS (159-162), _HOUSING_PROGRAM_DISPLAY (166-170), the two statements USER_ENTERED_FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_STATEMENT / USER_SELECTED_HOUSING_PROGRAM_STATEMENT (174-179), the helpers _fmt_feet (182-183), _fmt_degrees (186-188), _scope_statement (191-260), _user_choice_statement (263-269) and _rewrite_scope_lines (272-313). This block imports Source and Derived from .engine_conditions and is called once, from emit_three_way_document at line 584. The rest of the file (the answer/geometry/value-object logic and the public emit function) imports LABELS, Withheld, Source, Derived etc. from result_way_inputs/engine_conditions and stays. STEP 1 (the split). Create a NEW module services/api/app/scenario/three_answers/three_way_scope_lines.py. MOVE the scope-line block above into it verbatim (no character of any emitted string changes). The new module imports `from .engine_conditions import Derived, Source` and nothing from the decision module. In three_way_document.py add a compatibility facade: `from .three_way_scope_lines import (_rewrite_scope_lines, FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_KEY, HOUSING_PROGRAM_KEY, USER_CHOICE_KEYS, USER_ENTERED_FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_STATEMENT, USER_SELECTED_HOUSING_PROGRAM_STATEMENT)` and keep all five public names in three_way_document.__all__, because result_way_engine_bridge.py (lines 47-50) imports FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_KEY / HOUSING_PROGRAM_KEY / USER_CHOICE_KEYS from .three_way_document and re-exports them, results_read.py (lines 62-65) imports two of them through that bridge, and test_three_answers_three_way_emit.py imports the two STATEMENT constants from three_way_document. three_way_document keeps `from .engine_conditions import Derived` for the emit signature's type hint (Source is used only by the moved code). (reading) the natural boundary named by DB-205 a is exactly this block; nothing else moves. STEP 2 (the three DB-199 test gaps, all in test_three_answers_three_way_emit.py; NO app wording changes). (a) The helper _all_result_numbers (lines 180-206) walks only NAMED blocks (each answer's values, floor_by_floor, floor_stack, shortfall, best_combination, addon_gains, unit_estimate), so a withheld number placed in any other block would pass unseen (DB-199 a). Add a test that enters that state: take the emitted document, inject a numeric field into a block the walker does not visit, and assert the no-withheld-number guard FAILS (red proof); then strengthen the guard to walk the WHOLE document and assert it passes on the real emit and fails on the injected one (mutation proof: remove the whole-document walk and the injected-number test goes green). (b) The fallback at three_way_document.py lines 436-446 (the module shows legal_unit_limit_standard but the engine inner unit_estimate block is not available) is reached by no test and its two strings ('The legal dwelling-unit limit is not known: the figure it would be read from is not available for this lot.' and 'A recorded lot area, or a survey or deed dimensions.') are outside the transform text guard (DB-199 b). Add a test that enters that state: emit with ways that SHOW the standard unit limit while the engine document's inner unit_estimate is not available, and assert legal_unit_limit_standard is a withheld value_state carrying those exact two strings and that NO number appears for it (red proof: revert the fallback to append a value object and the no-number assertion moves). Bring the two strings under the transform text guard WITHOUT changing them (reference the literals, or hoist them to module constants whose value is byte-identical; a byte-identical hoist is not a wording change). (c) _unit_limit_value_object (lines 346-378) drops the rule_table source silently when rule_versions is missing, because _rule_version returns None (DB-199 c; the engine always emits the list). Add a test that enters both states on the shown standard limit: with a rule_versions list present the value object's sources include {kind: rule_table}; with the list absent or empty that source is absent and only the zoning_resolution source remains. Pin both branches (mutation proof: force _rule_version to always return None and the present-list assertion fails). TESTS REQUIRED: one test per input state above, a table in the producer report (state -> input -> expected), a red proof per new test, one mutation proof per pinned branch. NOT IN THIS TASK: no change to any shown or emitted string anywhere (the wording questions of the inventory are a separate owner-gated task); no change to the decision module (result_ways.py, result_way_inputs.py, result_way_conditions.py, result_way_bridge*.py), the engine (engine.py, answers.py, geometry.py, explanations.py, scope.py, dwelling_units.py), engine_disclosures.py, the route results_read.py, any schema, any fixture, any drawing/CAD/PDF code or the website; no change to contract_version or the document's structure; the import-guard test in test_result_ways.py is NOT edited unless the new module is forced to contain the substring 'result_way' (see risks).

RULINGS OF THE ORCHESTRATOR (after reading the draft against the code; not the builder's to change; a ruling that cannot be built as written is a STOP and a report).

B1 A MOVE, NOT A REWRITE. The scope-line block is moved character for character. The report shows the proof: the block as it stands in `three_way_document.py` at the claim head (lines 131 to 313), compared with the body of the new module (after its docstring and imports): no difference. No emitted or shown string changes anywhere.

B2 THE OLD PATH KEEPS EVERY NAME THAT ANYTHING NAMES THERE TODAY. `three_way_document.py` stays the import path for: `emit_three_way_document`, `HOUSING_PROGRAM_KEY`, `FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_KEY`, `USER_CHOICE_KEYS`, `USER_ENTERED_FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_STATEMENT`, `USER_SELECTED_HOUSING_PROGRAM_STATEMENT` (all in `__all__` as today) and, importable though private, `_rewrite_scope_lines` and `_HOUSING_PROGRAM_DISPLAY` (a website comment names the latter at that path; no website file is in this task).

B3 THE NEW MODULE NEVER CONTAINS THE LETTERS `result_way`, in code, comment or docstring (the guard test `test_only_task_m5_t130_bridge_and_facts_modules_import_the_decision_module` in `test_result_ways.py` reads every app file for that substring and is NOT edited). It imports from `.engine_conditions` only. Its seeded placeholder is replaced, not appended to.

B4 BYTE IDENTITY IS PROVEN BY EXISTING TESTS, UNCHANGED: the journey's byte-exact test (`tests/journey/test_215_16_northern_journey.py`, which compares the route's document with the committed file), the whole folder `tests/scenario/three_answers`, and `tests/api/test_results_read_api.py`. No committed fixture and no snapshot changes (`git status` shows none). Scenario S2 is met by these; add a new equality assertion only if you can show a state none of them covers.

B5 THE THREE TEST GAPS, EACH ENTERING EXACTLY ITS STATE. (a) the whole-document scan: the helper that collects a result's numbers walks the WHOLE emitted document, and a test injects a number where the old walk did not look and shows the old helper missed it. (b) the fallback: a test that reaches the branch at lines 436 to 446 and asserts the withheld state, its two exact texts and that no number appears; the two texts come under the existing text guard (`test_every_text_the_transform_writes_is_plain_and_true`) through constants whose values are the same characters as today. (c) the rule-table source: the REQUIREMENT pinned is that a shown standard unit limit carries its rule-table source when the document has its rule-versions list. The branch with the list missing is pinned too, but named as TODAY'S BEHAVIOUR (the source is dropped without a word) and not as a requirement; the report says so, and whether such a limit should be withheld stays an open question in the backlog (row DB-199 c). No behaviour of the emitter changes in this task.

B6 CHECKS ON THE BUILD MACHINE (the changed coding rules, owner rows D-090-R638 and R639): ruff, the touched folders named in the commands, and the size check. The whole server suite, the drawings, CAD and PDF snapshot suites and the browser tests are CI's: they run on the pushed head and are read there before any gate. Start no server.
business_reason: The next change to this emitter is blocked until it is split (DB-205 a; CLAUDE.md principle 16 and docs/CODE_MODULARITY_POLICY.md forbid growing an already-oversized file). The three DB-199 test gaps leave a document-scan hole, an untested fallback and a silent source drop that could each let a wrong or unsourced figure through later. Doing both now, with the document provably byte-identical, keeps every owner-settled wording (R038, R567, R568, R569) and the fail-closed promise (R164) intact while unblocking the file.
forbidden_paths: Do not change any emitted or shown string anywhere; this task moves code and adds tests only.
Do not edit the decision module: result_ways.py, result_way_inputs.py, result_way_conditions.py, result_way_bridge.py, result_way_bridge_overlay.py, result_way_facts.py.
Do not edit the engine or its text: engine.py, answers.py, geometry.py, explanations.py, scope.py, dwelling_units.py, contracts/engine_disclosures.py.
Do not edit the route results_read.py, any file under packages/contracts, any _contract_schemas, any drawings/kit, cad or documents code, or anything under apps/web.
Do not edit the import-guard test in test_result_ways.py unless the new module is forced to contain the substring 'result_way' (see risks).
No committed fixture, snapshot, schema or website file changes; start no server (ruling B6).
The new module never contains the letters `result_way` (ruling B3).
